community_list_entries.name: Control-Plane Placement Shapes Forgetting: An Architectural Study of Agent Memory Across Thirteen System Configurations

phase1_classification.kind_reason: An architectural study that releases the ForgetEval suite: 1,000 templated cases plus 385 adversarial cases, with an adapter protocol. It tests control-plane forgetting (supersede, release, purge) in external memory stores, not model weights. Released under MIT in the 'lethe' repo.
